content:
rachael.leads: Quick heads-up — we need to push release/rls-3.14 to prod tonight in the 01:00-02:00 UTC change window. Contractor @sourabh needs to run the final canary and promote. Who can grant temp prod deploy rights?

sourabh: I can do the canary+promote. I have company SSO but not enrolled in the Redwood MFA group (just personal 2FA). Happy to enroll now if required.

mike-sre: We don't give long-lived prod deploy perms to contractors. Use the JIT flow (Accessbot) or a short-lived deploy token via deploy-bot. Please open an access request with justification.

rachael.leads: Opening now: `/access request --env prod --who @sourabh --reason "hotfix regression rollout for rls-3.14" --duration 60m --approvers @mike-sre @luis-ops`

accessbot: Access request #3419 created for @sourabh (prod deploy) — awaiting 2 approvers. Link: https://redwood.internal/access/3419

anya-sec: @rachael.leads @mike-sre tagging security: we require MFA enrollment and a short justification in the ticket. Also flag: do not use shared svcacct keys — if a service account is required, use OIDC short-lived tokens and rotate after the window. Policy snippet: 
```
require_mfa: true
require_approvers: 2
svcacct_allowed: false (unless OIDC short-lived)
```

luis-ops: If approved, do a staged canary: 1% for 10m, 10% for 10m, then promote. Watch error-rate and latency. Rollback command if needed: `deploy-bot rollback rls-3.14 --to rls-3.13`

mike-sre: Approving after confirming MFA. @sourabh please confirm MFA enroll — security will validate. Approving request #3419 now.

accessbot: Request #3419 approved by mike-sre and luis-ops. Granting temporary role `prod-deployer` to @sourabh for 60 minutes. Token issued via deploy-bot. Audit log ID: AL-2026-03-20-77.

deploy-bot: deploy attempt started by @sourabh — canary at 1% (task id: dpl-20260320-77).

sourabh: Canary looking good at +6m — no errors, latency within SLOs. Proceeding to 10%.

deploy-bot: Promotion to 10% complete. Monitoring.

luis-ops: +1 on metrics; ready for full promote in 10m if stable.

sourabh: Promoted to 100% at 01:40 UTC. All checks green.

deploy-bot: Deployment succeeded: rls-3.14 -> prod. Audit: AL-2026-03-20-77. Temporary `prod-deployer` role revoked (expired).

anya-sec: Thanks — file a follow-up ticket to rotate any service-account credentials referenced in the release notes and attach the audit log.

rachael.leads: Will do. Created ticket OPS-9876 to rotate svcacct keys and attach logs. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
